title: Free 7-day trial, no strings
changes: The free Premium trial no longer requires voting on Top.gg. Run /activatetrial in your server and everything unlocks straight away - no card, no signup, nothing to install
Trials now last 7 days instead of 3, so you get a full week to actually use AI Voice Dispatch, the Priority Tracker and Applications
Every Premium feature now has a Start Free Trial button right where you hit it, instead of just telling you the feature is locked
Voting on Top.gg still helps other RP servers find the bot, it is just no longer required for anything
